headline: Accused of brainwashing investors, Zhaoji victims lament supporting policy yet being defrauded; reveal national development fund also invested - Politics
summary: Former Zhaoji Property Management chairman Li Chien-cheng is suspected of raising over NT$1 billion through an affiliated company and corporate bond issuance, and was detained without visitation. Victims say a national development fund also invested.
why: Zhaoji is a rental subletting firm, and alleged misuse of investor funds raises regulatory and investor-protection issues in Taiwan's property sector.
